column1: # Which genes the structure explorer offers, in display order, and why each is here.
# Input to `tools/build_gene_set.py`, which resolves every symbol against Ensembl REST
# and writes `structure_genes.tsv` next to this file. This is the *editable* half: a
# symbol, a display group, the group's label and rank, and one line of provenance. The
# ids, biotypes and the `coding` flag are never hand-written — they come from the live
# Columns are read by *name*, and only `symbol` and `group` are required. `group` is a
# free-form id: no code anywhere knows the three used below. `group_label` is the sentence
# the picker, the legend and the table headings show; `group_order` is the group's rank,
# which also picks its colour tone. Omit either and the id becomes the label and
# first-appearance becomes the rank. Every row of one group must state the same label and
# the same order, or the build refuses.
# A blank note for a panel gene borrows the panel BED's sixth column, so the reason a
# gene is on the candidate list has exactly one owner.
# The one *semantic* flag is `in_panel`, and it is not a column here at all: the server
# derives it from the panel BED, and it means "this gene carries the proband's annotated
# alleles". Group ids are display grouping and carry no such claim.
# Evidence for every mva-sac and extended note: docs/step-0/methodology/060.
